title: Book a test appointment
summary: A test appointment confirms that branches, rooms, doctors, availability and services work together.

steps.title: Create menu
steps.details: From here you create appointments, reminders and notes.

steps.title: Choose the patient
steps.details: Required. Search for them by name, ID or phone.
steps.description: Search for them by name, ID or phone. If they don't exist, you can create them from here.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: The service sets the appointment's duration. Without a service the appointment uses the calendar's default duration.
steps.description: The service sets the appointment's duration.

steps.title: Doctor
steps.details: Only doctors with availability at that time are offered.

steps.title: Room
steps.details: The room where the patient is seen. If the doctor has a default one, it's already chosen.

steps.title: Time
steps.details: If it falls outside the doctor's availability or the branch's hours, the calendar warns you before saving.
steps.description: If the time is outside the doctor's or the branch's availability, the calendar warns you.

steps.title: Save the appointment
steps.details: Saves the appointment. If the patient has a phone, they get the confirmation and the configured reminders.
steps.description: Review the details and press Save. With this the minimum is done.
